userMessage:
Page: "Radar" — the app's home view. British English throughout. Sections (top to bottom, mirroring the prototype mock-up):
1. Header: title "Change Radar", access-tier banner (from the latest crdr_collectionrun per collector, crdr_accesstier), and a "Demo data" badge whenever any crdr_asset has crdr_source other than live. Small "Ratings are LLM assessments (in-tenant), not fact" note.
2. Headline sentence (Format-RadarHeadline rules exactly: "N items need action, and M are rated high impact. The next deadline is yyyy-MM-dd: title." with the singular/zero variants).
3. Five tiles (Get-RadarSummary rules): Now (active incidents: source graph_health, horizon now), Action required, High impact, Retiring, Future (roadmap, horizon future). Tiles act as in-place filters on the sections below.
4. Filter bar: horizon (ordered by option value: Now, Imminent, Future — near to far, never alphabetical), source, product (from crdr_products, split on separators), theme, impact type. Filtering in place, no navigation.
5. Priority matrix: rows impact High (high+critical), Medium, Low (plus a "Not yet rated" strip); columns time to land: Next 30 days, 1–3 months, 3–6 months, Later or landed (Get-TimeBucket: 0–30, 31–91, 92–183, else, UTC calendar days from the date-only crdr_keydate). Cells list items (short title) with a colour bar for risk / opportunity / both and an action marker. Impact per Get-ItemImpact: live assessment override, else live estate impact if not none, else signal generic impact, else unrated. "Live" assessment = crdr_assessment for the signal with crdr_source = live.
6. Patterns across the items: per theme (crdr_theme on signal; themes from seed: Copilot Credits and consumption; Capability moving into Copilot; Governance and controls; Agents and Work IQ platform; Maker experience; Other) the count and item list.
7. What lands when: D3 timeline, rows Imminent, Retiring, Shipped, Future (Get-TimelineRow rules; incidents excluded), dots by key date, red ring = action required, a Today line.
8. Imminent table (horizon now/imminent, non-incident): When (key date + date label, Action badge), Product, Item (title + short summary text stripped of HTML), Impact (badge, type, audience, plus estate rating alongside when present), Risk and opportunity text with confidence, Ref (crdr_externalid linking to crdr_url).
9. Your estate: signals with open exposures (crdr_exposure status open/confirmed — check choice values), with affected asset counts by resource type and environment type, and the estate rationale/recommended action from the live assessment.
Every item opens the signal record in one click (Xrm navigation to crdr_signal form). Exclude inactive signals (statecode 0 only). Readable titles in full where space allows. Accessibility: WCAG AA, keyboard, labels; colours must not be the only carrier (text labels with risk/opportunity).
agentMessage: Built the Radar home page: headline and five filtering tiles, filter bar, priority matrix (impact against time to land), patterns by theme, a D3 "what lands when" timeline with a list view, the Imminent table, and Your estate (live exposures, then demo data kept separate). Read-only. Its rating logic mirrors engine/ChangeRadar.Radar.psm1 and passes tests/radar/radar.json (31 of 31).
